subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘PEOPLE’ is written as ‘NOEMEL’ and ‘TABLES’ is written as ‘RBAISE’. How will ‘MATURE’ be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• **First and fourth letter ⇒** (2) and (3) is subtracted from the first and fourth letter position value according to English alphabetic series respectively.
 
• **Second and third letter ****⇒** Interchanged their positions
 
• **Fifth and sixth letter ****⇒** Interchanged their positions

So,

 
• ‘PEOPLE’ is written as ‘NOEMEL’

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/405c47e9c33e146216b5e1f7a4f6a9fc19b0510f5b36b7f56f9bd5f3e7b1abfe.png] 

And,

 
• ‘TABLES’ is written as ‘RBAISE’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d0b6e2aa9605acdc6214240fd800395b4cd0d20b32e2763718e7fec6c96f171.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘MATURE’ will be written as :

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d83d3aefbe84ddba8dbf3e724a8e0e8b5d5873c5d74301043d6933555d3ef0d.png] 

​Hence, "**KTARER**" is the correct answer.

88:Tda
